translation_notes: rdf_graph.value(predicate=certainty, object=certainty_val_05) is the (predicate, object) -> subject form of g.value() (subject omitted): translated as m{ ?s {certainty} {certainty_val_05} }.first(), a single projected variable (?s) so .first() yields the bare subject term, matching g.value()'s any=True (no error on multiple matches, None on zero) exactly like the mapsa/blathers precedent in this stratum.

Restored bindings (kind=statement, no visible graph, rdf_ops=0 -- the pipeline's categoriser did not recognise the keyword-only .value(predicate=, object=) call as a graph read): wrapped the statement in get_mary_likes_matt_05(rdf_graph, certainty, certainty_val_05), matching the bindings the real enclosing test_rpt_case_15_4(name, rdf_graph) builds a few lines above this statement (certainty = URIRef(...); certainty_val_05 = Literal('0.5', datatype=xsd:decimal)) -- see original.py.

fixture.ttl is modelled on the real ex:certainty reification shape the region was extracted from (tests/data/rdf/cases/15_4.trig), simplified to a plain graph since the region itself never reads a named graph. Three statements carry three DIFFERENT ex:certainty values (0.5/0.75/1.0), driven by three separate calls in driver.py, each supplying its own (certainty, certainty_val) pair -- proving the lookup is keyed on the exact object, not merely the predicate. A fourth call supplies a certainty value (0.42) absent from the graph: the zero-solution case, None on both sides. Neighbourhood: ex:weight carries the SAME literal value (0.5) as one certainty triple on an unrelated predicate/subject, and ex:certainty 0.9 is the right predicate with the wrong object -- deliberately breaking the translation to ignore the predicate (m{ ?s ?p {certainty_val_05} }) was verified to make rdfeval check FAIL on this fixture, confirming the neighbourhood is not decorative.

article_candidate: one line before, one line after, and the construction (m{ }.first() with the SUBJECT unbound, predicate and object both given) is a case the trav_single_value idioms table only states in the (subject, predicate) direction -- worth showing the mirror case.

repair.driver: six calls added: the real tests/data/rdf/cases/15_4.trig (verbatim copy, fixture_15_4.trig) parsed into a ConjunctiveGraph as conftest.py does, with the four lookups of the real test (blank-node subjects in named graphs, Literal(1)); fixture_dup.ttl with two subjects for one (predicate, object) after a same-object ex:weight neighbour placed first, and a lexical variant "0.50" that term matching must not find.

last solution `(list(m{...}) or [None])[-1]` instead of .first() (dup: dupB)

The harness compares any two blank nodes as equal, so the trig calls prove a blank-node subject is reached, not which one (the choice is proved on IRIs by fixture_dup.ttl). meta.json says oracle: isomorphism for a region read by values (not mine to change).
